about:
Agri-Industrial Plastics Co. was founded in 1978 by Dick Smith in Fairfield, Iowa. The company began by collaborating with trade leaders to advance plastic blow molding technology and later invested in equipment to produce EPA-compliant fuel tanks. After 37 years at the helm, Smith stepped down as president in 2015 and his daughter, Lori, assumed leadership, continuing the family-owned operation.

The company operates a 340,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Fairfield housing 20 monolayer accumulator-head blow molding machines and eight multilayer continuous coextrusion machines dedicated to non-automotive fuel tank production. Its core processes include custom and extrusion blow molding, supported by engineering and design services, quality control, assembly, and packaging. The plant focuses on large-scale industrial parts such as fuel tanks and components for turf equipment, powersports, agricultural, and marine applications.

Agri-Industrial serves customers in the turf equipment, power sports, agricultural, marine, recreational equipment, lawn and garden, and watercraft industries. Notable clients referenced include EXCEL Industries/Hustler Turf Equipment, Kubota Manufacturing of America, and John Deere, all of which rely on the company for critical blow-molded components.

The company's stated vision is to be the leading provider of innovative, high-quality blow molded solutions. Its quality management system is certified to ISO 9001:2015 (without design) and includes APQP, Level III PPAP capability, hourly production inspections, and a Shape Grabber laser scanner for 3D dimensional verification against CAD models.
